_comment: Phase 2D.4 OpenAI-ES under act-v3 — Stage A, from scratch. Policy 80-64-64-20 (tanh, linear logits), 32 antithetic pairs = 64 perturbed policies per generation, one complete episode each, common random numbers (both members of a pair play the same training auction with the same action stream), centered-rank shaping (average ties), g = 1/(2N sigma) sum (s+ - s-) eps, sigma 0.05, Adam lr 0.01 eps 1e-8, no weight decay, 2,000 generations. Validation (masked argmax) at the first generation boundary at or after each of the eight PPO/A2C/DQN decision checkpoints and every 250 generations. Hard stop unless act-v3 5f72f510c48b1f46 and obs-v2 629b25783f833af7.
